questions.answer: I remember it as easy, no problems.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I could always write an e-mail if I needed help or information.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Somewhat, there were only a couple of classes I couldn't take do to scheduling.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember the deadlines and follow the instructions.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: The level was high

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: It was not as good as UCPH. It was very much based on long lectures, not a lot of group work.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Farm System Modelling, Poverty and Development Strategies, Waste Management and Waste Techniques, Economics and Environmental Policy,  Policy Processes in Agriculture and Natural Resource Management.

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
questions.answer: Master thesis

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Policy Processes in Agriculture and Natural Resource Management - it was really interesting and you had more group work than the other courses.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: I didn't attend any.

questions.answer: There were not that many activities, since it was during corona.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Parties. That is where you meet people.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend going around the countries, visiting the bigger cities in the area.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Easy.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Germans are a bit hesitant to speak english, so just be aware of that and be the one to start conversations.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: None.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The beer drinking.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- You have at least five courses at the same time, so make sure you plan your time well. 
- The lectures are long and monotone, so do the reading to get the most out of it. 
- Be open to Germans, since you probably have to be the one to start conversations.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Be aware that if you live close to campus in Hohenheim, you are half an hour from Stuttgart.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: The people I met

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: To meet people and connect with them. The university was pretty locked down because of corona, so it was difficult to meet new people.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
